units.source_text: 母尼僧迁居宇治院，下车的时候病势又重起来。

en.t: When the nun mother moved to the Uji villa, her illness worsened again as she got down from the carriage.

units.source_text: 大家都很担心，奔走忙乱了一会。

en.t: Everyone was very worried and hurried about in confusion for a while.

units.source_text: 等到病人稍稍安静之后，僧都问徒弟：“刚才那个人现在怎么样了？”

en.t: After the patient had quieted a little, the bishop asked his disciple, "How is that person from earlier now?"

units.source_text: 徒弟答道：“还是昏昏沉沉，一句话也不说，生气全无，定然是被鬼怪迷住了。”

en.t: The disciple replied, "She is still dazed and says not a word. There is no sign of life in her; she must surely be possessed by a spirit."

units.source_text: 那妹尼僧听见了，问道：“什么事？”

en.t: The younger nun heard this and asked, "What is the matter?"

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“是这么这么一回事。

en.t: The bishop answered, "It is a matter like this.

units.source_text: 我活了六十多岁，今天看到了一件怪事。”

en.t: I have lived more than sixty years, and today I saw a strange thing."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧听了这话哭起来，说道：“我在初濑寺中做了一个梦呢。

en.t: When the younger nun heard these words, she began to weep and said, "I had a dream at Hase Temple.

units.source_text: 是怎样的一个人？

en.t: What sort of person is it?

units.source_text: 快让我看一看。”

en.t: Please let me see at once."

units.source_text: 徒弟说：“就在这东面的边门旁边，请快去看吧。”

en.t: The disciple said, "She is beside the side gate to the east. Please go and look quickly."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧立刻跑过去看，但见其人身旁并无一人，被抛弃在那里。

en.t: The younger nun immediately ran over to look and saw that no one was beside the person, who had been abandoned there.

units.source_text: 这是一个非常年轻貌美的女子，身穿一件白绫衫子，系着一条红裙，衣香非常芬芳，气品高雅无限。

en.t: She was a very young and beautiful woman, wearing a white twilled silk robe and a red skirt; her clothing was richly fragrant, and her bearing was immeasurably elegant.

units.source_text: 她说：“这正是我所悲伤悼惜的女儿回来了！”

en.t: She said, "This is surely the daughter I have grieved and mourned for, returned to me!"

units.source_text: 一面哭泣，一面呼唤侍女，叫她们把这女子抱进室内去。

en.t: Weeping as she spoke, she called the serving women and had them carry the woman inside.

units.source_text: 侍女们不曾看见过她在树林中时的模样，所以并不害怕，就抱她进室内去了。

en.t: The serving women had not seen how she looked in the woods, so they were not afraid and carried her into the room.

units.source_text: 这女子虽然全无生气，却还能略微睁开眼睛来望望。

en.t: Although the woman seemed to have no life in her at all, she could still open her eyes slightly and look around.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧对她说道：“你说话吧。

en.t: The younger nun said to her, "Please speak.

units.source_text: 你到底是谁？

en.t: Who are you really?

units.source_text: 为什么来到这地方？”

en.t: Why have you come to this place?"

units.source_text: 但她似乎没有知觉。

en.t: But she seemed to have no consciousness.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧便拿些汤来，亲手喂她喝。

en.t: The younger nun then brought some broth and fed it to her with her own hands.

units.source_text: 但她一味昏迷，似乎就要断气的样子。

en.t: But she remained sunk in unconsciousness and seemed about to breathe her last.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧想：“我已认领她，如果她死了，反而增添我的悲伤。”

en.t: The younger nun thought, "Since I have taken her in, if she dies, my sorrow will only grow deeper."

units.source_text: 便对同来那个有法术的阿阇梨说：“这个人似乎要死了。

en.t: So she said to the ajari skilled in rites who had come with them, "This person seems about to die.

units.source_text: 请你快快替她祈祷。”

en.t: Please pray for her at once."

units.source_text: 阿阇梨说：“我早就说过不中用了。

en.t: The ajari said, "I told you earlier that it was no use.

units.source_text: 这是枉费心机。”

en.t: This is wasted effort."

units.source_text: 但他还是向诸神诵般若心经，又做祈祷。

en.t: Even so, he recited the Heart Sutra to the gods and performed prayers again.

units.source_text: 僧都也走过来探视，问道：“怎么样了？

en.t: The bishop also came over to look in on her and asked, "How is she?

units.source_text: 她究竟是被什么东西作祟？

en.t: What exactly is afflicting her?

units.source_text: 快制服了妖怪，问个明白。”

en.t: Quickly subdue the spirit and question it clearly."

units.source_text: 这女子还是昏迷不醒，似乎即将消逝的样子。

en.t: The woman still did not wake from her stupor and looked as if she would soon fade away.

units.source_text: 僧都的徒弟们便相与议论：“这人不会活了。

en.t: The bishop's disciples then discussed it among themselves: "This person will not survive.

units.source_text: 我等无端地遭逢这种不祥之事而耽搁在这里，实在倒霉。

en.t: We have had the bad luck to run into this ominous affair for no reason and be delayed here.

units.source_text: 然而这女子看来是个身份高贵的人。

en.t: Yet this woman appears to be someone of high rank.

units.source_text: 即使死了，也不能随随便便地抛弃在这里。

en.t: Even if she dies, we cannot simply abandon her here carelessly.

units.source_text: 这真是为难了。”

en.t: This is truly difficult."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧阻止他们，说道：“轻些儿吧！

en.t: The younger nun stopped them and said, "Keep your voices down!

units.source_text: 不要让人听见。

en.t: Do not let anyone hear.

units.source_text: 深恐引起麻烦。”

en.t: I am deeply afraid it will cause trouble."

units.source_text: 她怜惜这个人，定要把她救活过来，对她竟比对患病的老母更重视，不顾一切地悉心看护她。

en.t: She pitied this person and was determined to bring her back to life, caring for her even more than for her sick old mother and nursing her devotedly without regard for anything else.

units.source_text: 这个女子虽然不知来历，然而相貌生得异常美丽。

en.t: Although no one knew this woman's origins, her face and form were extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 因此所有的侍女都希望她不要死，尽力地服侍她。

en.t: Therefore all the serving women hoped she would not die and did their utmost to attend her.

units.source_text: 这女子有时也睁开眼睛来，眼泪淌个不住。

en.t: The woman sometimes opened her eyes, and tears streamed down without stopping.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧看了，对她说道：“唉，真伤心啊！

en.t: Seeing this, the younger nun said to her, "Ah, how heartbreaking!

units.source_text: 我知道你是佛菩萨引导到此，来代替我所痛惜的女儿的。

en.t: I know that the Buddhas and bodhisattvas guided you here to take the place of the daughter I mourn so bitterly.

units.source_text: 你如果死去，我反而更添悲伤了！

en.t: If you die, my grief will only increase all the more!

units.source_text: 我和你能在此相遇，定有宿世因缘。

en.t: That you and I could meet here must be due to karmic ties from a former life.

units.source_text: 你总得对我说几句话才好。”

en.t: You must at least say a few words to me."

units.source_text: 那女子好容易才开口说道：“我即使能活过来，也是个无用的废物了。

en.t: At last the woman managed to open her mouth and said, "Even if I can come back to life, I am already a useless wreck.

units.source_text: 请你不要让人看见，夜间把我扔进这条河里去吧。”

en.t: Please do not let anyone see me; at night, throw me into this river."

units.source_text: 那声音轻得几乎听不见。

en.t: Her voice was so faint it could scarcely be heard.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“你好容易说话了，我正高兴呢。

en.t: The younger nun said, "You have finally spoken, and I was just rejoicing.

units.source_text: 想不到你说出这难听的话来。

en.t: I never expected you to say such painful words.

units.source_text: 你为什么要说这可怕的话呢？

en.t: Why do you say such terrible things?

units.source_text: 你究竟是什么原因来到这地方的？”

en.t: For what reason did you come to this place at all?"

units.source_text: 但她不再说话了。

en.t: But she said no more.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧猜想她身上或许有伤残，所以不想活下去。

en.t: The younger nun guessed that perhaps the woman had some injury or deformity and therefore did not wish to live.

units.source_text: 但仔细察看，毫无缺陷，全身长得非常美丽。

en.t: But when she examined her carefully, there was no flaw at all, and her whole body was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 她就疑心：难道真是出来诱惑人心的妖魔化身？

en.t: Then she began to suspect: could this truly be an apparition of a demon come forth to bewitch people's hearts?
